Gear Fighter.name: Gear Fighter
Gear Fighter.description:
🔧 You win with support gear you tune and repair yourself: capture-tape launchers, grappling lines, smoke and flash grenades, gauntlets and thrusters.

🎯 You break enemy gear, build traps from scrap and push your own equipment past its safe limits.
⚠️ Without gear, tools or scrap at hand you fight as an untrained person, and a prototype can fail at the worst moment.
📈 You learn more techniques as your Support Engineering and Marksmanship improve.
⚖️ Hero support items must be approved and registered. Weapon-grade gear without a license or company permit is illegal, and modified gear loses its approval.
🤝 Support companies scout gear builders at the Sports Festival, and villains pay well for black-market engineers.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Support Engineering +15, Marksmanship +10
⚡ Starting technique: Tangle Shot
Gear Fighter.traitNarrativeEffects: Knows their gear inside out: accurate with snares and grenades, spots weak points in enemy support gear, field-patches gear, builds crude scrap devices. Starts with the items from their Gear Set and Path, kept working; prototypes fail at the worst moment when the scene calls for it. Devices use charges, rounds or parts; broken ones stay broken until repaired. Without gear, tools or scrap: untrained. Covers design, tuning, use; heavy metalwork and assembly is Fabrication. Pure training: same for Quirkless; techniques cost stamina, never Quirk Strain. Law: hero support items must be approved and registered (U.A.'s Support Course builds and tests them in the Development Studio, supervised); weapon-grade gear without hero license or company permit is illegal; modified gear loses approval. Support companies scout gear builders at the Sports Festival; villains pay well for black-market gear and engineers. Look: device belt, goggles up, greasy hands, pockets, cables.
